subject: ClearStream: p95 degradation — proposed emergency mitigation and traffic reroute for model Y12
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia@clearstream.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden p95 increase on model Y12 for production traffic

Hi Rafael / Monica,

We started seeing a ~65% increase in p95 latency for requests served by model Y12 around 07:40 PDT. Error rates are low but a significant number of our pages time out at the client level. This is impacting two high-volume endpoints (invoice-extract and line-item-normalize).

Can Redwood do an emergency mitigation (route traffic to a fallback variant or a cheaper variant) while we investigate? We'll need an approximate time window and confirmation that quality won't drop below our agreed threshold — ClearStream's SLO is strict for invoice parsing.

I've attached a short set of sample request traces and a p95 snapshot.

Thanks,
Alicia
Customer Success Lead — ClearStream Financial
ClearStream Financial

Attachments: p95-sample-logs.zip (attachment stub)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Ramos <alicia@clearstream.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 increase on model Y12 for production traffic

Thanks for the heads up, Alicia — sorry you're hitting this.

Kimberly / Marcus — can you validate whether this is an infra-induced tail event (kernel selection, batching fallback) or a model-side latency regression? If we can confirm it's behavioral in Y12 we should propose a temporary traffic reroute to the Y12-lite variant or to model Y11-stable as an emergency mitigation.

Important constraints:
- ClearStream requires minimal quality degradation for invoice parsing (we should surface expected precision/recall delta)
- They are on us-east-1 hosted cluster with reserved throughput
- Any traffic switch needs an automated canary for 10 minutes, then a staged ramp + monitoring hooks

Monica — can you hold the customer on a short window while we triage? I'll coordinate the rollback/fallback plan and get sign-off.

Rafael Mendes
Customer Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 increase on model Y12 for production traffic

Quick triage (initial):
- Observed: p95 for Y12 on ClearStream's tenant jumped from ~420ms to ~700ms at 07:40 PDT; tail correlates with a small increase in seq length for invoice-extract workstreams. No increase in 5xx.
- Infra factors: a small fraction of hosts tripped into a fallback kernel (see node 12-15). We've rolled a micro-fix that prevents kernel thrashing but the nodes need a drain cycle.
- Root cause hypothesis: combined effect of increased average input length + kernel selection path entering a slower execution route for ~10% of tokens.

Proposed emergency mitigation plan (ops play):
1) Activate routing policy to pin 40% of ClearStream traffic to Y12-lite (same behavior family, lower-quality quantized variant) and 60% stay on Y12 for immediate quality hedging.
2) Start a 10-minute canary at 3% traffic to Y12-lite, measure p95, token cost, and quality via the existing ClearStream eval set.
3) If canary p95 improves and eval quality delta <= 2.0% relative F1 on invoice parsing, ramp to 40% over 15 minutes.
4) Drain the affected nodes and push the kernel-thrash micro-fix; plan a rolling redeploy off-peak tonight.

Attachments: y12_p95_graphs.png, canary-runbook.pdf

Notes: This will temporarily increase token cost by ~8% for routed traffic due to redundancy, and the customer may request a temporary SLA concession window.

Kimberly Park
SRE — Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 increase on model Y12 for production traffic

A few product notes to consider before we send the mitigation to the customer:
- Y12-lite is quantized and has known edge cases for table layout inference; I recommend we run the ClearStream eval suite (it exists in their shared eval config) as the canary gating metric rather than only token-level metrics.
- If we route >30% traffic to Y12-lite we should enable prefix caching for invoice-extract (reduces repeated context overhead). That config change can be made in the console; I will open the change request and include automated monitors.
- We also need to flag billing impact and a temporary credit path if performance drops; finance approval (small concession) will speed customer acceptance.

I'll add the runbook link to the canary and open the console plan: https://console.redwood.ai/insights/clearstream/y12?preset=p95

Priyom Das
Product — Model Serving
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@clearstream.com>, ClearStream Infra <infra@clearstream.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed emergency mitigation plan — action and timing

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for the report — the team has triaged this and we propose the following limited, reversible mitigation to stabilize latency while we complete a node-level fix:

Proposed actions (start at 10:30 PDT):
- 10:30 PDT: initiate 3% canary routing to Y12-lite for invoice-extract only; evaluate p95 and F1 on your eval set for 10 minutes.
- 10:45 PDT: if canary metrics pass (p95 reduction and F1 delta <= 2%), ramp to 40% over the next 15 minutes.
- We will enable prefix caching for invoice-extract and run the kernel micro-fix; full roll is expected tonight (2:00–04:00 PDT).

Impact and asks:
- Expected p95 improvement for affected requests: from ~700ms back to ~420–480ms.
- Expected quality delta at 40% routed: up to 2% relative on invoice F1 (we will provide concrete eval results after canary).
- We recommend a provisional 6-hour SLA grace window for any transient quality regressions tied to this mitigation; please confirm if ClearStream will accept that.

If you approve, we will start the canary at 10:30 and share real-time dashboards.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Customer Engineering, Redwood Inference
